tutorials.title: Backdoor Learning: Recent Advances and Future Trends
tutorials.description: Foundations, attacks, defenses, benchmarks, and applications.

tutorials.title: From Devil to Angel: Backdoor Attacks for AI Copyright Protection and Beyond
tutorials.description: Tutorial on constructive uses of backdoors for AI copyright and ownership protection.

tutorials.title: Towards Theory-guided Backdoor Learning
tutorials.venue: International Conference on Mathematical Theory of Deep Learning
tutorials.description: Invited lecture connecting theoretical perspectives with backdoor learning; slides and a recording are available.

tutorials.title: MET CS 787: AI and Cybersecurity
tutorials.description: Fall 2026 course listing covering backdoor injection and defenses alongside broader AI security; the public page describes the syllabus and hands-on labs.

tutorials.title: Cryptography and Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Fall 2026–27 course with public notes and a scheduled backdoor unit on detectability, cryptographic constructions, and removal guarantees.

tutorials.title: CMSC 491/691: Robust Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Course with public slides, notes, and readings; its adversarial-attack unit includes backdoors and BadNets.

tutorials.title: Topics in Adversarial Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Research seminar with a public syllabus and reading list covering poisoning and backdoor attacks alongside robustness theory.

workshops.title: Backdoors in Deep Learning: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
workshops.description: Backdoor threats, defenses, and beneficial applications.

workshops.title: Cybersecurity for AI & AI for Cybersecurity (C4AI4C)
workshops.description: Broader AI and cybersecurity workshop whose stated scope includes model vulnerabilities such as backdoor attacks.

workshops.title: Adversarial Threats on Real Life Learning Systems
workshops.description: Workshop on deployed ML security with backdoor-focused keynote slides and a presentation on physical-world backdoors.

workshops.title: Deep Learning Security and Privacy (DLSP)
workshops.description: Broader deep learning security workshop explicitly soliciting poisoning and backdoor research, including modern generative and agent settings.

workshops.title: Building Trust in LLMs and LLM Applications
workshops.description: Broader trustworthy-LLM workshop whose poster program includes CleanGen, a defense against backdoors in language generation.

workshops.title: Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec)
workshops.description: Broader AI security workshop with accepted work on backdoor defenses, graph-model backdoors, and speaker-identification backdoors.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorBox
toolboxes.description: A unified Python framework for implementing and comparing backdoor attacks and defenses.

toolboxes.title: TrojanZoo
toolboxes.description: A PyTorch platform for evaluating backdoor attacks and defenses in image classification.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorBench
toolboxes.description: A unified evaluation framework for backdoor attacks and defenses in computer vision.

toolboxes.title: OpenBackdoor
toolboxes.description: A framework for implementing and evaluating textual backdoor attacks and defenses.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorToolbox
toolboxes.description: Image classification: shared implementations for backdoor attacks, defenses, and evaluation.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorLLM
toolboxes.description: LLMs: a shared framework for backdoor attack experiments and defense comparisons, including the Backdoor-DefenseBox module.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorDM
toolboxes.description: Diffusion models: integrated attacks, defenses, evaluation metrics, and visualization tools for image-generation backdoors.

toolboxes.title: BackdoorMBTI
toolboxes.description: Image, text, and audio classification: a common toolkit for configuring backdoor attacks and evaluating defenses across modalities.

toolboxes.title: BackFed
toolboxes.description: Federated learning: modular attack and defense evaluation with shared configurations and optional parallel client training.

toolboxes.title: Backdoors 101
toolboxes.description: Centralized and federated learning: a PyTorch framework with configurable tasks, trigger synthesizers, and backdoor experiments.

toolboxes.title: Mithridates
toolboxes.description: Training pipelines: wrappers and examples for measuring backdoor resistance and searching for more resistant training configurations.

toolboxes.title: Adversarial Robustness Toolbox (ART)
toolboxes.description: General ML security: a reusable library with backdoor poisoning implementations, including attacks on generative models.
